Empowered to learn. Inspired to contribute

At Microsoft, your career begins with possibility. Our Early in Profession opportunities are designed to help you grow with purpose—supported by teams working together to empower people and communities around the world. Whether you're joining from school, a bootcamp, or a career pivot, you’ll be part of a collective effort where every role contributes to meaningful outcomes—and you’ll be invited to learn, collaborate, and build alongside others. 

We know that growth isn’t linear. It comes from putting in the effort to do your best work, taking ownership of your path, and staying open to learning and evolving. That’s why we encourage thoughtful risks and learning through action. When missteps happen, we treat them as opportunities to reflect, adapt, and move forward—because progress is built on accountability and resilience. 

You’ll be guided by mentors and managers who help you shape your goals and stretch your potential. And as you grow, you’ll discover that your impact can ripple across teams, communities, and industries. Starting your career at Microsoft means joining a culture of shared success—where collaboration fuels innovation, and your journey can lead to endless possibilities. 

Internship programs
Global university internships

At Microsoft, our interns work on projects that matter – and your team will rely on your skills and insights to help deliver those projects to market. This is your chance to bring your solutions and ideas to life while working on cutting-edge technology. We offer internships in all job families and solution areas, and it’s open to current students in Bachelor’s, Master’s, MBA, PhD programs.

Discovery program

The Discovery Program is a unique opportunity for students who are passionate about technology and want to make a positive impact on the world and society. This four-week internship is open to rising first-year college students, based in Redmond, Washington or Atlanta, Georgia. Participants will work on a real project, learn from Microsoft employees and mentors, and explore different career paths in tech. 

Explore program

Explore Microsoft is a summer internship program specifically designed for first- and/or second-year college students. Gain experience in software development through a learning program where you get the opportunity to work in a pod alongside other Explore Interns.

PhD, MBA, JD internships

If you're pursuing a PhD, MBA, or JD and want to explore what it's like to work at Microsoft, look no further. We host PhD, MBA, and JD interns throughout our teams. Our PhD, MBA, and JD interns are active, contributing members to our  community. No matter what route you take, come work on meaningful, innovative projects that add to our company's success.

Corporate, External, and Legal Affairs (CELA) internships

The Microsoft Legal Intern Program is an extraordinary opportunity for aspiring legal professionals to cultivate their careers within one of the world's leading technology companies.

Rotation programs
HR Rotation
Finance Rotation
Cloud Supply Chain Rotation

Our HR rotation program is a 3-year program that fosters learning and growth in the HR profession and helps you jumpstart your career.

Learn more about the HR2P program

Microsoft Customer and Partner Solutions Early in Profession Program (MCAPS EiP)

The world is interested in AI and the world trusts Microsoft as their partner for AI transformation. Microsoft Customer and Partner Solutions (MCAPS) is the company's global unified commercial organization with responsibility for global strategy and sales execution. That’s our fancy way of saying we are making magic happen for customers and partners around the world. The MCAPS Early in Profession (EiP) program prepares the next generation of sales and technical leaders to enable AI transformation and solve mission-critical technology issues for our customers and partners.

 

The MCAPS EiP program is a three-year program designed to accelerate your growth. From day one, you'll dive into AI-driven tools and human-powered experiences that will help you become a sales or technical leader. You'll have a curated onboarding, skilling, and career development path that prepares you to deliver meaningful results for customers and partners.

Learn more about MCAPS EiP 
❯
Hiring programs
❮
Neurodiversity

We built the Microsoft Neurodiversity Hiring Program on the belief that neurodivergent individuals strengthen a workforce with innovative thinking and creative solutions. Diverse teams positively impact our company culture, working environment and how we serve our customers. 

"Learn more about the Neurodiversity Hiring Program"

Digital Sales Specialist - AI Business Solutions - AI workforce - German speaking
18 days ago
Ireland, Dublin, Dublin
3 days / week in-office

Start Date: November/December 2026 Come build community, explore your passions and do your best work at Microsoft. This opportunity will allow you to bring your aspirations, talent, potential and excitement for the journey ahead. Are you inspired to empower organizations to transform the way they work by harnessing the full potential of artificial intelligence? We are seeking individuals to help guide customers through the evolving digital landscape, enabling them to unlock new opportunities, enhance productivity, and deliver meaningful employee and customer experiences. Join us in integrating advanced AI capabilities across devices, cloud platforms, and everyday business applications to help organizations realize seamless, innovative, and secure solutions that drive sustained growth and success in the AI era. As a Sales Specialist - Workforce AI, you will lead the charge in driving AI transformation across enterprise customers by positioning Microsoft’s AI Business Solutions—including Copilot, Copilot Studio, Viva, and Cloud PC/Virtualization offerings—as strategic enablers of productivity and innovation. You will engage business decision makers through consultative selling, develop compelling business cases, and orchestrate cross-functional teams to accelerate adoption and value realization. This role empowers you to shape customer intent, build pipeline, and deliver measurable impact while deepening your expertise in AI sales motions and contributing to a high-performance, learning-driven culture. To prepare for the role, you will be enrolled in the Elevate and Early-in-Profession (EiP) Program. Microsoft’s Elevate and Early-in-Profession (EiP) programs exemplify the company’s commitment to developing early-career talent through robust onboarding and mentorship. These programs are designed to accelerate new hires’ productivity, integrate them into Microsoft’s culture, and set them on a path for long-term growth within the company. Participants in Elevate/EiP benefit from a comprehensive onboarding experience that includes immersive training, structured job shadowing opportunities, and continuous support from dedicated mentors. By investing heavily in the first six months of a new employee’s tenure, Microsoft ensures its early-in-career hires build essential skills, confidence, and professional networks that will enable them to excel. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. Responsibilities Drive AI transformation deals by conducting consultative selling conversations with business decision makers (BDMs), showcasing the value of Copilot, Copilot Studio, Viva, and Agents at Work. Act as a trusted advisor by aligning AI solutions to customer priorities, building compelling ROI-based business cases, and qualifying deals effectively. Accelerate paid Copilot growth through immersive engagements, extensibility strategies, and security-focused narratives. Partner with others cross-organizationally and support the development of end-to-end sales motions for Copilot Studio and Cloud PC/Virtualization (Windows 365 and AVD), including Intune Suite attach opportunities. Grow frontline worker (FLW) sockets and Copilot adoption, driving upsell and customer prioritization in collaboration with Digital Sales and Engineering teams. Support Agent 365、ME5、ME7 opportunities through partner-led motions and orchestrate deal closure with Commercial Executives. Engage with internal stakeholders to help build new pipeline and secure customer intent to buy by leveraging digital signals, partner workshops, and marketing events. Maintain accurate account plans and MSX updates, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities and consumption milestones. Coordinate cross-solution opportunities across Security, Business Applications, Surface, and Azure, partnering with ATU, CSU, FastTrack, and other stakeholders. Uphold compliance by modeling ethical behavior, completing required trainings, and proactively identifying and escalating risks. Lead technical GTM strategy for AI Workforce. Qualifications Required Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Business, Technology, Marketing, Human Resources, or a related field, and/or up to 2 years experience in technology sales, consulting, customer success, or account management. This role requires proficiency in written, reading, and conversational English & German, as you will be assigned to the German Customer Market. Business Relationship Management: The ability to develop and maintain positive working relationships with supervisors, staff, managers, customers, and vendors. This includes expressing empathy and compassion when dealing with the needs and problems of others, being approachable, taking time to address the concerns of coworkers, and treating others with respect and dignity. Consultative Selling: The ability to understand customer needs through dialogue before recommending products/services. Conflict Resolution: The ability to manage conflict, disharmony, and strife among people and situations, while recognizing and addressing sensitivities. This role is based in Ireland and has a work site flexibility of up to 50% work from home. If applying, please consider that you may be required to relocate to meet the requirements of this role. Preferred Qualifications Decision Making: The ability to make decisions in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment. This includes the ability to define, diagnose, and determine an appropriate resolution, recommendation, or decision while considering alternatives and factors (e.g., resources, costs, trade-offs). Creativity: The ability to apply ingenuity, inventiveness, and imagination to the inclusive design and construction of a product, service, program, or initiative. Negotiation: The ability to achieve mutually satisfying agreements in negotiations with others by listening to their objectives, acting as the company's representative to effectively communicate the company's objective, and seeking common ground and collaborative solutions. Microsoft Products: Knowledge of Microsoft products/services and the ability to participate in technical conversations related to products/services. Fundamental level credentials/certifications on Microsoft of competitive Cloud and/or AI Platforms. #EIP Digital Solution Area Specialists IC2 - The typical base pay range for this role across Ireland is € 44,000.00 - € 57,200.00 per year. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. Find additional benefits and pay information here: https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/corporate-pay/ireland-corporate-pay.html This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about requesting accommodations.

Customer Success Account Manager
4 days ago
India, Multiple Locations, Multiple Locations
3 days / week in-office

The CSAM is an early-in-career Customer Success Account Manager who delivers standardized customer success outcomes spanning executive partnership, solution health, cloud adoption, and AI acceleration activities. These CSAMs act within a pod model. Working under the direction of CSAMs and a M1 Manager, the CSAM operates within a defined pod covering a shared portfolio of accounts. The role contributes to portfolio-level intelligence, execution orchestration, and reactive signal aggregation – reducing context-switching for senior CSAMs and accelerating customer outcomes. This is a talent-engine role: CSAMs are AI-first, customer-facing from month three, and grow through structured cohorts and community. Responsibilities Executive partnership and execution Execute standardized executive partnership, solution health, cloud adoption, and AI acceleration tasks under direct guidance from senior CSAMs or CSU leaders. Support agent and Copilot adoption motions across assigned pod accounts. Complete assigned activities accurately and on time; escalate exceptions rather than independently diagnose them. Portfolio-level intelligence and preparation Maintain deep, current account context across the pod’s defined portfolio. Synthesize account signals into “what’s changed / what matters now” Detect risks, upcoming deliveries, upcoming milestones, and open threads. Detect portfolio patterns such as recurring blockers across multiple accounts. Execution orchestration (not delivery) Track delivery and milestone progress with partners and CSAs on behalf of CSAMs. Map dependencies across workloads and milestones. Proactively flag drift before the customer raises it. Coordinate remediation follow-ups across internal teams. Reactive signal aggregation Monitor reactive support signals – case volume, aging, repeat drivers – across the pod portfolio. Aggregate reactive trends into portfolio-level views and surface early warnings of escalation risk. Track follow-through on Support, IM, and Service Manager commitments; chase stalled internal owners. Distill reactive noise into CSAM-ready insights, not raw data. Operating model Operate within a pod model covering a shared portfolio of accounts. Work under direct oversight of the M1 Manager and senior CSAMs assigned to the pod. Limit interactions to task execution and information capture; executive partnership and account governance is led by the senior CSAM. Qualifications Required Qualifications Bachelors in Technology (any specialization) 2-4 years of professional experience in program management, customer-facing operations, technology delivery, or analytics. Demonstrated comfort with AI tools and AI-first ways of working. Strong written and verbal communication in English. Preferred Qualifications Coursework or experience in program management, technology, or business operations. Exposure to enterprise software, cloud platforms, or B2B customer success. Experience working in pod, squad, or matrixed team structures. #EiP This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about requesting accommodations.

Applied Sciences Intern
3 days ago
United Kingdom, London, London
3 days / week in-office

Come build community, explore your passions and do your best work at Microsoft with thousands of University interns from every corner of the world. This opportunity will allow you to bring your aspirations, talent, potential—and excitement for the journey ahead. As an Applied Science Intern at Microsoft, you will be at the forefront of technological innovation, working collaboratively to bring research to life in our products and services. You'll gain expertise in cutting-edge research areas, apply advanced concepts to real-world needs, and use state-of-the-art tools to make a tangible impact on product quality and business outcomes. You'll contribute to the creation of intelligent solutions through data analysis, modeling, and machine learning, ensuring our products remain at the leading edge of innovation. At Microsoft, Interns work on real-world projects in collaboration with teams across the world, while having fun along the way. You’ll be empowered to build community, explore your passions and achieve your goals. This is your chance to bring your solutions and ideas to life while working on cutting-edge technology. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. Responsibilities Contribute in the development of state-of-the-art techniques advancing the capabilities of Microsoft 365 Copilot, with a particular emphasis on graph-based information retrieval, contextualization and personalization, LLM prompt engineering, LLM post-training, synthetic data generation, and LLM-based evaluation. Gain a deep understanding of your area of research and applicable research techniques, as well as a basic knowledge of industry trends and share your knowledge with immediate team members. Systematically document and analyze proposed methodologies with the aim of producing technical reports to share with your team and partners. Contribute to the development of scalable with the goal of creating prototypes for enhancing the Microsoft 365 user experience. Assist with the development of usable datasets for modeling purposes and support the scaling of feature ideation and data preparation. Qualifications Required Qualifications You must be legally authorised to work in the United Kingdom to be eligible for this role. (Legally authorised = has citizenship or has been granted a valid visa or work permit) Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or a Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, Artificial Intelligence or a related field OR currently pursuing a PhD with a relevant project Demonstrated interest in research or applied AI (e.g., academic projects, open-source contributions). Preferred Qualifications Experience developing or applying predictive analytics, statistical modelling, data mining, or machine learning algorithms. #EiP This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about requesting accommodations.

Internship programs

  • Global university internships

    At Microsoft, our interns work on projects that matter – and your team will rely on your skills and insights to help deliver those projects to market. This is your chance to bring your solutions and ideas to life while working on cutting-edge technology. We offer internships in all job families and solution areas, and it’s open to current students in Bachelor’s, Master’s, MBA, PhD programs.

  • Discovery program

    The Discovery Program is a unique opportunity for students who are passionate about technology and want to make a positive impact on the world and society. This four-week internship is open to rising first-year college students, based in Redmond, Washington or Atlanta, Georgia. Participants will work on a real project, learn from Microsoft employees and mentors, and explore different career paths in tech. 

  • Explore program

    Explore Microsoft is a summer internship program specifically designed for first- and/or second-year college students. Gain experience in software development through a learning program where you get the opportunity to work in a pod alongside other Explore Interns.

  • PhD, MBA, JD internships

    If you're pursuing a PhD, MBA, or JD and want to explore what it's like to work at Microsoft, look no further. We host PhD, MBA, and JD interns throughout our teams. Our PhD, MBA, and JD interns are active, contributing members to our  community. No matter what route you take, come work on meaningful, innovative projects that add to our company's success.

  • Corporate, External, and Legal Affairs (CELA) internships

    The Microsoft Legal Intern Program is an extraordinary opportunity for aspiring legal professionals to cultivate their careers within one of the world's leading technology companies.
